Name: rPerf
Comment: Performance = ideal cycle x count / run time [0..1]

Name: rOee
Comment: OEE = A x P x Q [0..1]

Name: udiGood
Comment: Good picks in the current shift

Name: udiNg
Comment: Failed picks in the current shift

Name: udiFaults
Comment: Fault events in the current shift

Name: rMtbfMin
Comment: Mean time between faults [min], EMA smoothed

Name: rMttrMin
Comment: Mean time to repair [min], EMA smoothed

Name: audiRobCycles
Comment: Grip-cycle thresholds per robot (0 = counter disabled) 1..GC_ROBOTS

Name: bAnyDue
Comment: TRUE when at least one threshold is reached

Name: auiFail
Comment: Ids of the failed checks (0 = unused slot)

Name: sMsg
Comment: Message of the first failure (English, operator facing)

Name: stRun
Comment: Wall clock of the last run (v1.8.0)
